lock.title: EmailOps is locked
lock.subtitle: Enter your main password to continue
lock.forgotHelp: Removing the password requires re-adding your accounts. There is no recovery — all data is local.

layout.intro: Pick the inbox layout that fits how you work. You can change this any time from Settings → Appearance.
layout.splitDesc: Email list on the left, content on the right. Best for quick triage on wide screens.
layout.fullWidthDesc: Single-column list. Open an email to read it in full. Best for focused reading.

addAccount.intro: EmailOps connects directly to your email provider — no proxy server, no third-party access. Pick your provider to get started.
addAccount.gmailWaiting: Waiting for Google sign-in… complete the browser flow.
addAccount.outlookWaiting: Waiting for Microsoft sign-in… complete the browser flow.
addAccount.outlookIdle: Sign in with Microsoft OAuth (Graph API)

aiChoice.intro: EmailOps is a privacy-first email client. AI features run locally on your machine always and your data never leaves your device unless you choose a remote provider.
aiChoice.useAiRecommended: ✓ Recommended — this machine can run AI locally
aiChoice.useAiAvailable: Needs {{minRam}} GB RAM — this machine has {{ram}} GB
aiChoice.useAiHardware: Hardware: {{minRam}} GB+ RAM, ~5 GB disk for the default model.
aiChoice.plainTurnOnLater: You can turn AI on later from Settings → AI.
aiChoice.reversible: Either choice is reversible. Toggling AI off later preserves all extracted data.

aiBackend.introPrivacy: Other AI email tools send your messages to OpenAI or Google. We download the AI to your computer so we never have to.
aiBackend.introModels: EmailOps needs two small models — one for chat and one for search — that run entirely on this computer.
aiBackend.embeddingBundled: Email search uses a small AI model that comes built-in with the app — no download needed.
aiBackend.embeddedDetail: Bundled models. No server, no setup.
aiBackend.ollamaDetail: Requires the Ollama app running on this computer.
aiBackend.openrouterDetail: Use any cloud LLM via OpenRouter. Requires an API key.
aiBackend.chatHelp: Used for chat, classification, memory and task extraction. Pick the smallest one this computer can comfortably run.
aiBackend.ollamaFinishHintRest: from Settings → AI after onboarding (server URL, model name). No models are downloaded by EmailOps for this backend.
aiBackend.apiKeyHelpPart1: Stored in your {{store}}. Get a key at
aiBackend.testOptional: Optional — verifies the key + chat model before continuing.
aiBackend.continueTitleOpenrouter: Enter an API key and chat + embedding model IDs to continue
aiBackend.continueTitleChat: Download a chat model to continue
